title: Robust Mechanism Design on Networks with Externalities
abstract: arXiv:2609.35907v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how to allocate a good with positive externalities among agents in an information network, without monetary transfers. Each agent observes their own valuation and those of their neighbors. A principal seeks to allocate the good to the highest-valuation agent through a mechanism robust to agents' heterogeneous belief hierarchies, leveraging the network structure and the partial incentive alignment created by allocative externalities. We characterize the networks for which a robustly efficient mechanism exists: it exists if and only if at least two agents are connected to all others. Relaxing robustness to rule out weakly dominated strategies, one universally connected agent suffices. We generalize the results to a broader class of utility functions, show that robust welfare maximization is impossible unless the network is complete, and establish that an ex post incentive compatible mechanism that is efficient under truthful repor

translated_title: 具有外部性的网络上的稳健机制设计
translated_abstract: 我们研究如何在信息网络中的代理人之间分配一种具有正外部性的物品，且不涉及货币转移支付。每个代理人可以观察到自己的估值以及其邻居的估值。委托人希望通过一个对代理人异质信念层级稳健的机制，将物品分配给估值最高的代理人，并利用网络结构以及分配外部性所产生的部分激励一致性。我们刻画了存在稳健有效机制的网络类型：当且仅当网络中至少有两个代理人与所有其他代理人相连时，这样的机制才存在。若将稳健性条件放宽为只需排除弱被支配策略，则仅需一个与所有代理人相连的代理人即可。我们还将结果推广到更广泛的效用函数类别，证明除非网络是完全图，否则稳健的福利最大化是不可能实现的，并建立了在真实报告下有效的事后激励相容机制。
tldr: 在具有正外部性且无货币转移的网络物品分配问题中，稳健有效的机制存在当且仅当网络中至少有两个代理人与所有其他代理人相连。
en_tdlr: In allocating a good with positive externalities over an information network without monetary transfers, a robustly efficient mechanism exists if and only if at least two agents are connected to all others in the network.
